Dataset Purpose: Measures short-term changes in industrial production volume across Mining, Manufacturing, and Electricity sectors.
Geographic Coverage: Nation-wide, compiled and published by the National Statistical Office (NSO).
Population Coverage: Covers all industrial enterprises within the country’s defined industrial sectors.
Key Variables: Monthly production volume indices for Mining, Manufacturing, and Electricity sectors.
Sample Size / Scope: Monthly, comprehensive coverage of all relevant industrial sectors; no specified sample size due to census-like coverage.
Important Notes: Published by NSO; reflects volume changes, not value or price; sector-specific data is included.
